newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber exec to join Patriot American.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber exec to join Patriot American.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said on Friday it has appointed William W. Evans, managing director of PaineWebber Group Inc's real estate group, to its Office of the Chairman, effective March 1.
Patriot American said Evans will be responsible for identifying, negotiating and closing corporate mergers and acquistions.

Evans will also work with chairman and chief executive officer Paul Nussbaum in directing certain strategic planning efforts and capital markets transactions and take the lead in negotiating and closing other financial transactions, it said.
Patriot American is a hotel real estate investment trust with a portfolio currently consisting of 52 hotels with 12,329 rooms.
